answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 51 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 10 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 51 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 580 bought sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the hollow here is verification, the opal of cost is what stops the farm, and the grove of the record keeps every claim checkable.
